crossRefs.note: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.
Jacob said to Pharaoh, “The years of my pilgrimage are one hundred thirty years. The days of the years of my life have…
For we are strangers before you, and foreigners, as all our fathers were. Our days on the earth are as a shadow, and…
Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.”
For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.
My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.
Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.

translations.web: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)
translations.bsb: For we were born yesterday and know nothing; our days on earth are but a shadow.
translations.kjv: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow:)
